title: Baby toy baby early education enlightenment book
body_html:
[Brand] Multi-functional three-dimensional cloth book

[Specification] about 18*19cm
[Fabric] Cloth + polyester fiber filling

6 pages and 12 pages on the back cover
[Age] 3-36 months

A multi - functional three-dimensional cloth book, the color is particularly bright

With portable and zipper, it is a good cloth book for baby to recognize color, shape and learn dressing.
